# MSRTC Bus Info — Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation

> Public transportation enquiry directory, station master contact numbers, and intercity bus route schedules for Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation (MSRTC / ST Mahamandal).

MSRTC operates over 16,000 buses across 250+ depots in Maharashtra, serving over 6.5 million passengers daily across iconic services: Shivneri Volvo AC, E-Shivneri Electric, Shivshahi AC, Hirkani Asiad Semi-Luxury, and Parivartan (Lal Pari) Ordinary Express.

## Core Helplines & Contact Desks
- Statewide 24x7 Customer Care: 1800-22-1250 (Toll-Free)
- Mumbai Central ST Depot: 022-23024074
- Pune Swargate Bus Station: 020-24449980
- Pune Shivajinagar Bus Station: 020-25536970
- Nashik CBS Thakkar Bazar: 0253-2309308
- Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar CBS: 0240-2240184
- Nagpur Ganeshpeth Central Stand: 0712-2726221
- Kolhapur CBS Bus Station: 0231-2650620

## Key Intercity Corridors
- [Pune to Mumbai (Shivneri AC)](https://msrtc.shivrajsinh.in/routes/pune-to-mumbai-bus-time-table) — Every 15 mins (24x7) via Expressway
- [Mumbai to Pune (Shivneri AC)](https://msrtc.shivrajsinh.in/routes/mumbai-to-pune-bus-time-table) — Every 15 mins (24x7)
- [Pune to Shirdi](https://msrtc.shivrajsinh.in/routes/pune-to-shirdi-bus-time-table) — Every 30 mins
- [Mumbai to Shirdi](https://msrtc.shivrajsinh.in/routes/mumbai-to-shirdi-bus-time-table) — Hourly via Samruddhi / Kasara
- [Pune to Nashik](https://msrtc.shivrajsinh.in/routes/pune-to-nashik-bus-time-table) — Every 30 mins
- [Kolhapur to Pune](https://msrtc.shivrajsinh.in/routes/kolhapur-to-pune-bus-time-table) — Every 20 mins via NH-48

## Government Concessions & Welfare Schemes
- Mahila Samman Yojana: 50% fare concession for all women passengers statewide.
- Amrit Varishtha Nagrik Yojana: 100% free travel for senior citizens aged 75 and above; 50% discount for ages 65-74.

## Sourcing
Official MSRTC disclosures at msrtc.maharashtra.gov.in and online reservation portal npublic.msrtcors.com.
